price.title: Electricity prices
price.description: Where NibePi reads the electricity prices for the price component. Each loaded Tibber integration is listed by name.

data_description.price_source: Tibber: prices from the tibber.get_prices action. Price sensor entity: a Nordpool or similar sensor with the prices in its attributes. None: the price component contributes 0.

tibber_warning.title: Tibber account

system_s1.title: Climate system {system}
system_s1.description: Room sensors and setpoint. Everything else is under Configure after setup.

data.indoor_entity: Indoor temperature sensor, e.g. Netatmo (empty = pump's BT50)
data.rmu_entity: Room temperature for the pump's RMU40 (empty = the indoor sensor)

data_description.indoor_entity: Used by the indoor component, which adjusts the curve offset. Recommended: a room sensor such as Netatmo's indoor module. Staleness is judged by its last report, so an unchanged value is not stale. Left empty, the pump's BT50 room sensor (register 40033/40032) is used.
data_description.rmu_entity: Sent to the pump as the room temperature of a virtual RMU40 when the switch 'Send room temperature to pump (RMU40)' is on (off by default). With the pump's own room sensor correction on, switch the indoor component off, or the correction is applied twice (see the README).
data_description.setpoint: Also the cost optimiser's target indoor temperature.

house.title: House
house.description: The cost optimiser starts from a model built from these and learns the rest from the history. Location from Home Assistant: {latitude}, {longitude}, {elevation} m, {time_zone} (Settings -> System -> General).

data_description.house_era: Sets the starting heat loss. Unknown: a middle value, learned with a wider range.
data_description.house_construction: Thermal mass. Light: timber frame; medium: timber on a concrete slab; heavy: concrete or brick.
data_description.house_emitter: Floor heating: the optimiser models the slab, which delays the effect of an offset change by hours and keeps heating after it, and plans ahead for it.
data_description.house_sensors: How many room sensors the indoor value is an average of. One sensor in a house with several floors gets a safety margin.
data_description.meter_entity: A power sensor (W, kW) or an energy meter counting up (Wh, kWh, MWh). Calibrates the heat pump's efficiency; never used to steer.
data_description.meter_scope: The heat pump only: its readings are the heat pump's electricity, calibrate the efficiency directly and give the actual heat pump cost per day. The whole house: the heat pump's share is estimated from its activity, which needs weeks of data.
data_description.optimizer_min_level: With the heating strategy 'Optimiser' its plan steers only when the house model has at least this confidence; otherwise the rules (indoor, price, forecast) do.

error.tibber_homes_failed: Could not list the Tibber homes ({error}). Enter the home's nickname from the Tibber app, or leave empty to use the first home.
error.meter_unit: The meter needs a unit of W, kW or MW (power), or Wh, kWh or MWh counting up (energy).
error.comfort_floor: The hard floor must be further below the setpoint than the comfort band.

data.price_very_cheap_below: Own threshold: very cheap at or below (öre)
data.price_very_expensive_above: Own threshold: very expensive at or above (öre)
data.weather_forecast_adjust: Shift forecast by measured outdoor temperature

data_description.sensor_timeout: An indoor or outdoor value older than this counts as missing and its component gives 0.
data_description.price_source: Tibber: prices from the tibber.get_prices action. Price sensor entity: a Nordpool or similar sensor with the prices in its attributes. None: the price component contributes 0.
data_description.price_unit_factor: 100 when prices are in SEK/kWh (Tibber, most sensors), 1 when they are in öre/kWh.
data_description.price_very_cheap_below: Set both thresholds to replace the optimiser's level.

hotwater.title: Hot water
hotwater.description: Hot water control and VV learning, ported from NibePi's Node-RED VV-AI. Turn the features on with the hot water switches and the Hot water mode select (shadow first). See docs/hotwater.md.

data.hw_learning_rate: Learning rate (1-10 % per draw and day)
data.hw_min_drop: Smallest BT6 drop that counts as a draw (°C)
data.hw_price_window: Price search window before a peak (h)
data.hw_optimizer_floor: Cost optimiser: hot water floor, BT6 (°C)
data.hw_legionella_temp: Legionella temperature when the pump's is unreadable (°C)
data.hw_legionella_interval: Legionella interval when the pump's periodic increase is off (days)
data.hw_legionella_hold: Legionella: minutes BT7 must hold the temperature
data.hw_legionella_window: Legionella: length of the cycle window (h)

data_description.hw_learning_rate: How much one draw moves the learned value of its hour, and how fast hours without draws fade (vv_ai_learning_rate).
data_description.hw_min_drop: A fall of BT6 (hot water load) smaller than this is not learned (vv_ai_min_drop).
data_description.hw_day_small: A day (02:00-02:00) whose learned draws sum to less than this gets no planned heating.
data_description.hw_peak_threshold: A second hour of at least this, 6 h or more from the day's largest, gets its own heating window.
data_description.hw_use_price: VV-AI control places each window in the cheapest hours before the peak and heats only in its two cheapest hours (or the last two before the peak).
data_description.hw_min_temp_enable: With VV-AI control, BT7 under the floor heats to the floor + 4 °C. VV-AI control keeps the pump from heating hot water on its own, so keep this on.
data_description.hw_autolux_diff: A BT6 fall this large within the time below starts a one-time increase (temporary lux).
data_description.hw_comfort_very_cheap: With price comfort mode on, the pump's hot water comfort mode (47041) for each price level. Unchanged: the pump's own setting.
data_description.hw_optimizer_floor: With 'Optimise hot water charges' on, the optimiser's tank plan keeps BT6 above this.
data_description.hw_legionella_enable: With hot water mode active, run a legionella cycle (47047 = the legionella temperature, one-time increase) when the pump's own periodic increase has not reached the temperature in time. Every BT7 hold at the temperature counts, also the pump's own. In shadow mode the plan is only shown.
data_description.hw_legionella_temp: The pump's periodic stop temperature (47046) is used when it can be read.
data_description.hw_legionella_interval: With the pump's periodic increase on (47050), its interval (47051) is used, and the guard waits one more day for the pump.
data_description.hw_legionella_window: The cycle starts in the cheapest window of this length before it is due.

away.title: Away (vacation)
away.description: Away mode lowers the heating while nobody is home: switch 'Away' (e.g. from your alarm automation) or the nibepi.set_away action with an expected return. What is written to the pump still depends on the Mode and Hot water mode selects: in shadow mode Away is only computed. See the README.

data.away_curve_offset: Curve offset while away without indoor control
data.away_preheat: Heat back before the return (cost optimiser)

data_description.away_setback: The indoor setpoint (and the cost optimiser's comfort target) is lowered by this much while away. The nibepi.set_away action can override it.
data_description.away_min_indoor: Absolute floor: the lowered target and the optimiser's hard comfort floor never go below this (frost and damp protection).
data_description.away_curve_offset: Rules strategy: when the indoor component is off or has no usable sensor, this fixed component lowers the curve instead. With indoor control active it is 0: the lowered setpoint already pulls the curve down.
data_description.away_hot_water: Economy: comfort mode economy, no planned charges or boosts, the pump heats hot water itself; the min-temp floor stays. Normal: unchanged. Minimum: with VV-AI control on, only the min-temp floor keeps the tank warm.
data_description.away_preheat: With the cost optimiser and a known return time, plan so the house is back at the normal target when you come home.
data_description.away_return_lead_h: The rules and hot water return to normal this many hours before the return time; the optimiser ramps its comfort band over it. 0: at the return.

options.economy: Economy (pump heats itself in economy mode)

tibber_missing.title: Tibber prices are not available
tibber_missing.description: NibePi is set to read electricity prices with the tibber.get_prices action, but the Tibber integration is not set up or not loaded. Set up the Tibber integration, or choose another price source in NibePi's options. Until then the price component contributes 0.

legionella_failed.title: Legionella cycle did not complete
legionella_failed.description: NibePi's legionella guard ended a cycle without BT7 reaching the legionella temperature ({result}). It tries again in 12 hours. Check that the pump can reach the temperature (immersion heater allowed for hot water, the stop temperatures) and that BT7 is reported. The issue clears when BT7 next holds the temperature.

import_vv_profile.name: Import Node-RED hot water profile
import_vv_profile.description: Replaces the learned hot water draw profile with the one NibePi's Node-RED VV-AI learned (vv_ai_profile.json). Copy the file into Home Assistant's configuration directory first.

path.name: File
path.description: Path of vv_ai_profile.json, relative to the configuration directory (e.g. nibepi/vv_ai_profile.json). Files outside the configuration directory are refused.

config_entry_id.name: NibePi entry
config_entry_id.description: Only needed with more than one NibePi integration.

set_away.name: Set away
set_away.description: Starts or ends Away (vacation) mode for every climate system and hot water. With a return time, Away ends by itself then.

enabled.name: Away
enabled.description: On starts Away (or changes a running one), off ends it.

until.name: Until
until.description: Expected return: Away ends by itself at this time. Empty or in the past: no end. A time without a zone is Home Assistant's local time.

setback.name: Setback
setback.description: °C below the setpoint while away; empty: the option (default 3).
